description: Daily fortune snapshot (0–100 score + advice) for a given Day Master and date. Provide the Day Master either as a Korean stem character (갑, 을, 병, 정, 무, 기, 경, 신, 임, 계) or an English alias (e.g. wood_yang, water_yin). The Day Master comes from a prior saju_calculate / saju_interpret call (day_master.stem).

date.description: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

day_master.description: Day Master: Korean stem (갑..계) or English alias (wood_yang, wood_yin, fire_yang, ... water_yin).

lang.description: Output language (default ko). One of: ko, en, ja, zh, es, pt-br, vi, id, hi, th

name: saju_daily
title: Daily Fortune Snapshot
